required_outcomes: Treats the Monday 10-12 slot as tentative, since the call says the tenant will confirm by text, and does not tell anyone that a visit is booked.
Moves the booking forward now: asks the provider (or the tenant, who said she would confirm) to confirm the Monday slot with its date, so it can be set as soon as it is confirmed.
Leaves a dated follow-up (hold or scheduled follow-up) to check the booking within about two days.
acceptable_alternatives: Tells the tenant the landlord has approved and the provider will confirm the time, instead of messaging the provider, provided a dated follow-up checks the booking.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the caller, company and tenant names in the call differ from the record without letting it hold up the booking.
Keeps the landlord's existing approval (event 009) and does not ask for it again.
red_flags: Asks the landlord again for an approval already given in event 009.
Escalates the booking to a human.
prohibited_actions: Books or announces a firm visit date the provider has not confirmed, such as Saturday 30 August, which is not a Monday and was never agreed.
critical_failures: Tells the tenant or the provider that a visit is booked for a date nobody confirmed.
